candidate.title: Duplex-Seq
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina Duplex-Seq row: random-index adapter addition, ligation/PCR, sequencing, separate single-strand consensuses, and their integration into a rare-variant duplex-consensus result. The verified secondary page is headed "Duplex-Seq: Duplex Sequencing" and depicts the same target. Duplex Sequencing is the expanded name here, not an additional workflow. The adjacent Safe-SeqS and DR-Seq rows and the clipped flow-cell workflow above are catalogue context, not alternatives or branches of this target. The targeted capture adaptation mentioned only in the catalogue prose is outside this schematic. Primary-paper support inspected here is abstract-only; exact adapter chemistry and implementation settings are not asserted.

states.label: Input double-stranded DNA with a rare mutation
features: The biological target and input substrate are DNA; the colored mark is shown at the same position on both strands.
The left-hand "Very rare mutation" icon describes the target. No mutation-generating laboratory operation is depicted.

operations.label: Ligate and PCR
operations.description: Ligate the primer/index-bearing adapters onto the DNA template and PCR-amplify the resulting tagged DNA, yielding the library sent to sequencing. The joint caption is retained as one broad preparation block.
